risks.title: Inflationary pressures and input costs
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in risks section with strong language: negatively impact profitability, materially adversely impact demand. Context involves rising raw material and logistics costs, impacting profitability and ability to execute strategy.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Extensively detailed in Risks Related to Our Business section with clear language on impacts: disrupt our or our suppliers' ability, adversely impacted. Risk is heightened by dependence on single suppliers and long lead times.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and IT vulnerabilities
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in dedicated section with strong language: material adverse effects, loss of data or intellectual property. Adoption of new technologies such as AI increases complexity of protection, and suppliers are also vulnerable.

risks.title: Concentration of customer base
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a major risk with quantified examples of customer concentration. Language is direct: substantial loss of sales, reduction in anticipated cash flows. Loss or insolvency of key customer would have significant impact.

risks.title: Risks related to new business launches
risks.score_rationale: Specifically mentioned for solar sector, with clear risks: execution challenges, uncertainty in market demand. Language indicates uncertainty regarding profitability and strategic objectives.

risks.title: Demand volatility and overcapacity
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in context of Optical Communications and Display segments. Language is clear on potential impact: material and negative impact on our financial results. Market overcapacity or undercapacity is a key factor.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in dedicated section, language emphasizes potential difficulties: difficulties in protecting our intellectual property rights, loss of market share. Litigation is mentioned as a costly and uncertain possibility.

ai_positioning.summary: Corning recognizes the impact of artificial intelligence on its business strategy, particularly in the Optical Communications segment where rapid AI acceleration is generating strong demand for fiber optic and connectivity products inside and between data centers.
evidence: MD&A Overview: 'optical fiber, cable and connectivity solutions for advanced communications networks, such as fiber to the home and data centers, enabling artificial intelligence and connections around the world'
Business section: 'the rapid acceleration of artificial intelligence (AI) is driving strong demand for fiber and connectivity products inside and between data centers'
